[[File:Tycho-headshot.png|thumb|right|200px|Tycho Celchu served as Rogue Five]]
'''Rogue Five''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Rogue Five was usually in command of Rogues Six, Seven, and Eight who collectively would make up Second Flight.

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] designated Rogue Five flew under the command of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. While [[Battle of Sluis Van|dogfighting]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] over the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]], Antilles and "Rogue Five" uncovered an Imperial plot to hijack the New Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] stationed there for repairs.<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] ([[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]])<ref name="SW15">[[Star Wars (2013) 15|''Star Wars'' (2013) 15]]</ref>
*[[Ardana Cinn]] (0 ABY)<ref name="SW18">[[Star Wars (2013) 18|''Star Wars'' (2013) 18]]</ref>
*[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Dix Rivan]] (3.5 ABY)<ref name="SOTE novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
*[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] ([[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]&ndash;[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 1|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 1]]</ref><ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Gavin Darklighter]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="X-Wing: Rogue Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*[[Tal'dira]] (7 ABY)<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
*Wes Janson ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="X-Wing: Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Inyri Forge]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]&ndash;[[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:DT">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref><ref name="NJO:BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
